comment: The one ffmpeg every build, CI job and `make ffmpeg` uses. BtbN keeps each month's last autobuild long-term, so pin to one of those. To upgrade: pick a newer month-end autobuild-YYYY-MM-DD-* release at https://github.com/BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds/releases, copy the *-linux64-gpl-X.Y.tar.xz / *-win64-gpl-X.Y.zip names and their sha256 digests here, and let CI render-test it.
